alt: DNA structure - double helix of two antiparallel strands. Sugar-phosphate backbone (deoxyribose + phosphate) with nitrogenous bases (A-T, G-C) projecting inward and pairing by hydrogen bonds. The structure carries genetic information. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
